text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: high variance in metering counts for hosted API. Alerts: token_count_diff > 15% for 12 clusters, several customers flagged for overage. Investigate ASAP. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/metering/alerts/2176543210

oncall-amber: I'm on it, grabbing context. which pipeline is raising the delta? :eyes:

billing-eng-jamal: seeing repeated 'delayed-ingest' alerts from ingestion-queue. Over-rate flags started around 09:08 UTC. Affected customers: acct-8432, acct-1190, acct-7002 (high-touch).

sre-alex: checking consumer lag now. `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group metering-consumer` shows lag ~120k on topic `token-usage`.

prod-ops-maria: looks like a backlog spike on eu-west region. kube events show OOMs earlier on `metering-consumer-2`. Logs: 

```
2026-02-11T09:04:12Z metering-consumer-2 ERROR ProcessOOM: killed
2026-02-11T09:04:14Z metering-consumer-2 WARN reconnecting to kafka
2026-02-11T09:05:30Z metering-consumer-2 INFO resumed consumption
2026-02-11T09:07:50Z metering-ingest INFO write to delta-agg delayed by 3m
```

incident-bot: system note: auto-flagged 18 customers for potential overage; probe threshold exceeded.

oncall-amber: immediate plan: 1) confirm ingestion backlog 2) restart metering-consumer(s) 3) run manual backfill job for last 20m 4) unflag customers until counts reconciled. Any objections?

billing-eng-jamal: +1 to unflag until we verify counts. We should also suspend automated billing notifications for impacted accounts so customers aren't spammed.

sre-alex: restarting pod now in eu-west: `kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/metering-consumer -l region=eu-west`
sre-alex: restarted, watching logs. tailing: `kubectl -n redwood logs deploy/metering-consumer -f --since=10m`

ingest-bot: consumer lag falling: 120k -> 12k -> 2.3k within 4m.

prod-ops-maria: kicked off backfill job: `scripts/metering/backfill --from 2026-02-11T09:00:00Z --to 2026-02-11T09:20:00Z --customers acct-8432,acct-1190,acct-7002`

finance-ops-kevin: FYI finance: we'll need a list of accounts that had overage flags and timestamps, plus whether charges were emitted. If charges were created we need to hold/credit until recon. Pls keep ledger team in loop.

oncall-amber: quick reconciliation check: compare `raw-token-reads` vs `billed-token-agg` for sample customer acct-8432. Query attached: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM raw_token_reads WHERE ts >= '2026-02-11T09:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-02-11T09:20:00Z'` -> raw=1,203,112 ; billed=987,430 -> delta ~18%.

billing-eng-jamal: that matches alert pattern (drift 15-20%). Looks like writes were delayed and some windows double-counted earlier during backlog, then compacted — pipeline produced inconsistent aggregates during recovery.

incident-bot: note: created incident INC-20260211-37 and paged sev2. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/incident/metering-backlog

prod-ops-maria: backfill job completed for key accounts, ingestion delta reduced to <2%. Manual unflagging queued.

oncall-amber: decision log: 
- Restarted metering-consumer in eu-west (rolled) :hammer:
- Backfilled 09:00-09:20 window for impacted accounts
- Suspended automated overage emails for those accounts via billing toggle: `billing.toggle_overage_notifications(false, [acct-8432,acct-1190,acct-7002])`
- Created billing hold until reconciliation completes (ticket FIN-5342)

billing-eng-jamal: action items for postmortem: 1) add consumer OOM auto-scale; 2) add consumer lag alert that triggers before overage auto-flag; 3) add idempotency fixes to delta aggregation to avoid double-counts during recovery.

finance-ops-kevin: please attach final reconciled CSV (acct, window_start, raw_tokens, billed_tokens, action) to FIN-5342. We'll decide credits by EOD.

sre-alex: follow-up checks: memory limits on metering-consumer increased from 1Gi -> 2Gi for eu-west; autoscaler tweak PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/prs/4532

prod-ops-maria: monitoring note: set temporary throttling on auto-flag rule to 30m to avoid churn while backfill runs.

oncall-amber: customer comms: reach out to account owners for acct-8432/1190/7002 with a short note: "we identified delayed usage ingestion that may have temporarily flagged your account for overage. No charges will be applied pending reconciliation." Draft in #customer-notifications and ping me for review.

billing-eng-jamal: I've unflagged the 18 customers in the alert (command run). Confirmation: alert state cleared.

incident-bot: monitoring: delta percent across clusters now 1.4% (under threshold). Auto-flagging resumed (healthy).

oncall-amber: closing actions: 1) include incident root cause and mitigations in postmortem 2) schedule follow-up with ledger team re: credits 3) track PR for autoscale and idempotency. I'll mark incident resolved in 1hr if no regressions.

finance-ops-kevin: acknowledged. Logging FIN-5342 with expected credit window.

prod-ops-maria: marking runbook updated with new autoscale steps.

sre-alex: leaving notes in the kube objects and tagging the deployment with `incident=2176543210` for traceability.

oncall-amber: thanks team. reassigning rest to postmortem channel. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: incident INC-20260211-37 status -> mitigated (09:16 UTC), monitoring -> normal (09:22 UTC).
